properties.displayName: [Baseline] Resources inherit the required tag from their resource group
properties.description: Adds the required tag (default: CostCenter) to any resource that is created or updated without it, copying the value from the parent resource group. Combined with the resource-group tag requirement this gives full cost-attribution coverage with zero per-deployment effort. Existing untagged resources can be brought into compliance with a remediation task.

metadata.description: Modify rewrites incoming requests and powers remediation tasks; Disabled turns the policy off.
The tag copied from the resource group when a resource lacks it.
